data_separation.climate_only_group: same prototype/service/equipment/economics; replace traceable climate only
data_separation.regional_design_or_economics_group: separate named group; each changed parameter has admitted source

calibration_input_contract.oracle_moment_diagnostic_if_run: separate name and scope, never merged into candidate success

fair_comparators.different_hard_constraint_families: record explicitly as method design; infeasibility counted, not removed

state_and_evaluation.full_model_reference_if_available: separately named and timed; not substituted for selected policy
state_and_evaluation.comfort_capacity_boundary_and_resource_c: per policy, before declaring actual feasibility

selection_and_constraints.cost: admitted variable electricity bill for finite policy library; broader system cost only if separately admitted
selection_and_constraints.budgets: predeclared common actual baseline times unchanged multipliers, not method-specific estimates
selection_and_constraints.budget_baseline_exposure: if full-season baseline energy is used, disclose offline information and include simulation cost
selection_and_constraints.no_estimated_feasible_or_no_actual_libra: explicit failure/no-choice state; never dereference missing oracle
selection_and_constraints.oracle: same frozen finite library, same physical actual service and budgets
selection_and_constraints.negative_or_nonfinite_regret: audit comparator and feasibility rather than promote result

required_metrics.population: all frozen cases, policies, budgets, failures and unfavorable results; zero denominators explicitly handled

acceptance_logic.numerical_acceptance: valid weights, common bounds/mass and all declared hard moment residuals independently pass
acceptance_logic.estimation_advantage: paired all-policy errors assessed separately for bill and energy; no selective-policy averaging
acceptance_logic.decision_advantage: actual-feasible choices with lower finite-library regret or improved actual-feasible selection coverage under frozen common budgets
acceptance_logic.selected_actual_over_cap: not valid cost improvement; retain estimates and failure
acceptance_logic.claims: scope to frozen windows, prototype, price account and finite policy library

compute_accounting.calibration_only_timing_label: allowed if explicitly separate from total pipeline and includes failed calibration
compute_accounting.reason_limits_pending: parent must freeze concrete common limits before confirmation; reviewer does not invent already adopted budgets
